beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In Jerusalem there was a man named Nicodemus. He was a Pharisee, and more than that — a ruler of the Jews, a member of the great council that governed the nation's faith. Educated. Respected. Listened to. A man like that had everything to lose by being seen with a controversial teacher from Galilee. His seat, his standing, his name.

card.text: Jesus never shamed the fear, and never shamed the night. He just answered the real question underneath — and let the courage grow on its own. Have you ever felt drawn toward something, and been afraid to let anyone else see it?
